one_sentence_story: Studying Patient Elliot and the four-deck Iowa Gambling Task, Antonio Damasio and Antoine Bechara proved that without ventromedial prefrontal circuits linking past consequences to subtle bodily 'gut warnings,' even a 97th-percentile IQ drowns in indecision and risky traps.
so_what_for_you: Stop treating healthy emotion as the enemy of reason: use math and data to verify the facts, then notice whether experienced 'somatic markers' flag long-term trouble — and cap equal-tie minor choices at two minutes.
